senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; אוּד, עוּד, cmp. עֵת, אִידָּנָא)turn, due day, whence

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 13:12">Gen. R. s. 13</cite>, v. <cite ref="A00368"><he>אֵד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 7b:6">Ab. Zar. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>יום אֵידָם</he> the very day of their festival.—Pl. <he>אֵידִים</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 1:2">Ib. I, 2</cite>, a. fr. (<he>של נכרים</he>) <he>אֵידֵיהֶן</he>.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 2a:3">Ib. 2ᵃ</cite>; Y. Erub. V, beg. 22ᵃ (controversy as to spelling with <he>א׳</he> or with <cite ref="P00000"><he>ע</he></cite>). [As to cacophemistic designation, cmp. <cite ref="A00112"><he>אבידן</he></cite> &c.]
